text: The book states the maximum energy extractable from an extremal Kerr black hole via the Penrose process is approximately what fraction of its rest-mass energy Mc²?
explanation: The book gives the maximum extractable energy as (1 − 1/√2)Mc² ≈ 29% for an extremal Kerr hole, drawn from its rotational energy at the cost of slowing the spin. The other figures come from accretion, not the Penrose process: 5.7% is the Schwarzschild accretion efficiency, 42% is the extremal-prograde-Kerr accretion efficiency, and 0.7% is nuclear fusion.
